messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — Customer Zeta is asking for an on‑prem POC (3 nodes) and wants the onprem license + 6 months of support bundled. They asked if we can waive the VPC/platform fee for the POC window. Need to know what approvals we need and any guardrails.
josh (SE): Quick Q — what support level do they expect? Standard or Premium? Response times differ and Premium includes oncall escalation.
liz (Solutions): They asked for enterprise SLA in the POC doc, so probably premium ask. Also need to confirm whether onboarding services are included or charged separately.
tom (SalesOps): For waiving platform fee we usually require Deal Desk approval + commit to a paid contract after POC or an exec signoff. What are their likely commit levels?
maria (AE): They said "if POC looks good" they'd consider a 12‑month reserved commit at ~$150k/mo equivalent. Not signed. We're trying to avoid blocking the POC.
rebecca (Legal): If we waive fees for the POC we should limit liability and ensure revocation clause in SOW. Also check export controls for their region.
josh (SE): Technical note — onprem requires our remote SRE access for patches unless customer opts out; that changes support scope. Need KMS/HSM details: if they mandate HSM we need entitlements and additional SKUs.
maria (AE): Good point. I asked them for KMS requirements but no answer yet.
liz (Solutions): Proposal ideas: 1) Waive platform fee for a 90‑day POC if they sign an LOI for >12mo commit within 45 days after POC; 2) Keep platform fee but give a full credit applied to first invoice if they convert; 3) Offer 50% discount on onboarding services + Premium support at a discounted rate. Which route is least risk?
tom (SalesOps): Option 2 is lower legal risk. Option 1 is doable but requires Deal Desk + RevOps approval and a clause that fees kick in if LOI not received.
maria (AE): We need a quick answer for the customer today. Can SalesOps pre‑approve a standard template?
tom (SalesOps): I can pre‑approve a draft credit approach with finance — but Deal Desk needs to sign off on any platform fee waiver. I'll loop them in.
rebecca (Legal): If we do Option 1, Legal wants a defined rollback and indemnity carveouts. Also clarify data deletion responsibilities post‑POC.
josh (SE): Also add: if they require HSM integration, that requires extra time and a service addenda. Not included in standard POC timeline.
billing-bot: Estimated POC SKU quote: Onprem License (3 nodes) = $45,000/mo, Platform fee = $6,000/mo, Premium Support = $12,000/mo. POC 3 months total list = $183,000.
liz (Solutions): If we do credit applied on conversion (option 2) we can offer to apply up to the platform fee + onboarding cap = $24k.
maria (AE): Okay — next steps: Tom, can you open a Deal Desk thread and request platform fee waiver contingency (LOI OR applied credit)? Tag Finance. I’ll push customer to sign LOI draft if they want the waived fee.
tom (SalesOps): On it. I'll create the Deal Desk ticket and ping @finance. Also attaching our standard POC addendum template link: https://redwood.internal/sales/poc-addendum (draft).
rebecca (Legal): I'll prepare a short SOW clause for rollback + data deletion + limited liability for the waived fee scenario.
josh (SE): I’ll draft the technical appendix: remote access scope, KMS/HSM options, and expected onboard timeline (2–3 weeks).
maria (AE): Great — can we aim for Deal Desk reply by EOD? Customer expects an answer tomorrow morning PST.
tom (SalesOps): Will escalate. If Deal Desk needs more info I’ll schedule a 15min sync with reps and SEs.
liz (Solutions): FYI — for any waived platform fee we never waive onboarding services unless there's a conversion commit.
maria (AE): Noted. Thanks everyone. I’ll update the customer with the credit option for now and say we're seeking internal approval for any waiver. :thumbsup:
rebecca (Legal): Thanks — I'll DM the SOW language once ready.
josh (SE): +1. I’ll include KMS questionnaire for the customer to complete.
maria (AE): Closing loop — customer replied they prefer option 2 (credit on conversion) for speed. Moving forward with that while Deal Desk reviews waiver possibility.
tom (SalesOps): Copy. Created DD ticket #DD-8427 and tagged @finance and @revops.
billing-bot: Ticket DD-8427 attached quote snapshot and cost breakdown.
